numerical.qsa_coordinate_semantics: Selected-token sets reconstructed from native [batch,1,query,key] bool masks; canonical ascending IDs with -1 padding. Native top-k rank order is not exposed.

gpu.scope: All 48 routers and 12 QSA selected-token sets at last four queries of native 128- and 2053-token forwards; native bool masks converted to canonical ascending key IDs with -1 padding, not top-k ranks; short PLE lookup; common-input/fixed-route expert and hyper-connection replays at four blocks. The 2053-token screen exercises active QSA budget selection.

npu.scope: All 48 routers and 12 QSA selected-token sets at last four queries of native 128- and 2053-token forwards; native bool masks converted to canonical ascending key IDs with -1 padding, not top-k ranks; short PLE lookup; common-input/fixed-route expert and hyper-connection replays at four blocks. The 2053-token screen exercises active QSA budget selection.
